description: Ask for a draft sequence to start sending. Called over the API or MCP this does NOT activate it: it creates a pending approval and returns its requestId, and the sequence starts — enrolling future matching leads and mailing them on its timer — only when a signed-in person approves it in the fnlowl dashboard. Tell the user it is waiting for their approval there. Editing the sequence withdraws a pending request, so call this again after any change. An already-active sequence returns status active and no request.

project.description: A project id from list_projects. Runs this call in that project instead of the connection default.

name: activate_sequence
title: Activate sequence
